items.title: Formula For Rate of Flow (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Formula For Rate of Flow: a main subheading of 5.8 Steady, non-viscous and ideal fluid, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 104-104.

blocks.text: Ek pipe lein jis ka cross-sectional area A hai (Fig. 5.14). Fluid ki velocity v hai aur woh time t tak behta hai. Time t mein fluid ka tay kiya faasla:

blocks.alt: Pipe ek lamba khula cylinder hai jis ka cross-sectional area A hai. Andar fluid ka rangeen column lambai v x t ka hai, jo pipe ke neeche do dashed lines ke beech dohre teer se dikhaya gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.14: Liquid ka rate of flow (kitab ki Figure 5.14 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Yahan ℓ pipe ki woh lambai hai jo fluid time t mein tay karta hai. Time t mein pipe se guzarne wale fluid ka volume:

blocks.latex: \text{Thus}\quad \text{The rate of flow of the liquid} = \frac{\text{Volume}}{\text{Time}} = \frac{Avt}{t} = Av
blocks.text_alt: Thus The rate of flow of the liquid = Volume/Time = Avt/t = Av

blocks.text: SI units mein rate of flow cubic metre per second (m³ s⁻¹) mein napa jata hai; kabhi kabhi litre per second (L s⁻¹) mein bhi.
